name: Vivid VR - 4K NAS Video Player
summary:
Vivid VR turns Meta Quest into a private movie theater for the videos you already own.

STREAM FROM YOUR NAS AND PC
- Connect to shared folders on a NAS (Synology, QNAP, UGREEN and more) or a PC over SMB and play videos directly, with no copying to the headset
- Jellyfin / Emby: browse your home server libraries and stream
- Play videos saved on the headset too
- Smooth 4K and high-bitrate playback
- DVD / Blu-ray ISO images (unencrypted) with chapters, subtitles and audio tracks
